=== INDEPENDENTS: SHIPS + STATIONS PROMPT TEMPLATE =================================

The Independents (free ports and ships that answer to no empire) have two station
designs (Lotus Gardens and Violet Sun, the Minoans' old ones) and placeholder
haulers: existing sprites recoloured steel and emerald with tools/recolor_sprite.py
(ship_traced_drifter, ship_traced_prospector). These two sheets give them designs
of their own (more stations, and real haulers). Same canvas and layout as the other sheets
(player_ships_1.png, stations_1.png): tools/extract_sprites.py cuts them by grid.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
HOW TO USE
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 1. Attach player_ships_1.png (for the style, scale and layout) and send PROMPT A.
 2. Attach stations_1.png and send PROMPT B.
 3. Check each against the CHECKLIST; regenerate until it passes.
 4. Save them as external/images/independent_ships_1.png and
    external/images/independent_stations_1.png and ask Claude to cut them in
    (it adds them to tools/extract_sprites.py and swaps the placeholders out).

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
THE INDEPENDENTS (copy unchanged into both prompts)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Civilian free traders and free ports of a far-future Greek-inspired galaxy, who
answer to no empire and stay neutral in every war. Practical, patched-together,
well-travelled: bare brushed steel and gunmetal hulls, panels of mismatched
grey, cargo frames and docking clamps, emerald-green running lights, trim and
engine glow. No empire's colours, crests or symbols (no owls, lambdas, bull
horns, lapis-and-gold, laurels), no skulls or pirate motifs.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PROMPT A - SHIPS
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Make a sprite sheet in exactly the same style, scale, camera and layout as the
attached sheet: 1536 x 1024 pixels, pure black background, a 4 x 3 grid of 12
spaceships, each centred in its cell with clear black space all round it (no
part touching another cell), seen straight from above, nose pointing RIGHT,
no text or labels, no shadows on the background.
{THE INDEPENDENTS}
Row 1: four freighters of different shapes (bulk hauler, container carrier,
tanker with round tanks, long modular freighter).
Row 2: two mining haulers (ore drills or claws at the nose, ore bins), a courier,
an explorer with a sensor dish.
Row 3: four light escorts the free ports hire (a fighter, an interceptor, a
gunship with turrets, a small frigate) - armed but civilian, same steel and
emerald livery.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PROMPT B - STATIONS
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Make a sprite sheet in exactly the same style, scale, camera and layout as the
attached sheet: 1536 x 1024 pixels, pure black background, a 4 x 3 grid of 12
space stations, each centred in its cell with clear black space all round it,
seen straight from above (top-down, roughly round or symmetric silhouettes that
read well while slowly spinning), no text or labels.
{THE INDEPENDENTS}
Twelve different free ports: trading posts with docking arms and cargo pods,
waystations, a refinery port, a mining depot, a market ring with many berths,
a caravanserai of docked freighters, a repair yard - every silhouette distinct
from the others and from the attached sheet's.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CHECKLIST
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[ ] 1536 x 1024, black background, 4 columns x 3 rows, nothing crossing a cell
[ ] top-down; ships' noses point right
[ ] steel / gunmetal with emerald lights only - no empire colours or symbols
[ ] no text, numbers or watermarks
[ ] every design clearly different from the others
